scope: why the web-surface runs produced no identity reading, and what it corrects
cause: the provider was installed into the headless profile only. The web runs launched with --profile web, whose node_modules cannot resolve @tsunagou/dsh-host-identity, so the overlay's entry did not mount and the conversation had no Tsunagou tools at all
correction_of_an_earlier_claim: this round's report said the enrolled worker conversation 'returned agent beb92813 on the web surface'. That reading came from the newest tool/result in the session log, which is that conversation's own earlier history - not from the prompt this probe sent. The web surface was never shown to reach Tsunagou. The claim is withdrawn.
what_the_earlier_run_did_establish: the writer-held refusal is real and is caused by leftover web processes holding a write handle; after stopping the executor's own test processes, session/prompt is accepted and the conversation really runs
why_no_tools_is_the_safe_direction: an overlay whose entry cannot mount yields a conversation with no Tsunagou tools, which is the fail-closed behaviour the four wiring fixes aimed at - the opposite of handing over an identity
still_not_verified: A -> B -> A identity switching inside one host process
a shortest main/worker task and message loop
